article.story: STILLWATER, Okla. -- — Audi Crooks reached double figures for the 106th straight game, scoring 20 points to move into ninth on the Big 12 Conference all-time scoring list in No. 25 Oklahoma State's 103-61 win over Little Rock on Friday night. Crooks was 8-of-11 shooting and 4 of 5 from the foul line. The Cowgirls (6-1) made 12 3-pointers on 20 attempts and shot 69% (37 of 55) overall. Nene Ndiaye added 17 points, Stailee Heard 15, Liv McGill 14 and Yuting Deng 12. Heard had nine rebounds and McGil seven assists. Neso Anisiobi led the Trojans (1-5) with 16 and Talia Kemp added 13. Little Rock shot 44% but only had five 3s. The Cowgirls shot 69% (18 of 26) in the first half to take a 48-22 lead. The Trojans shot 33%. After Little Rock took a 7-6 lead, Heard and McGill combined for eight-straight points and Oklahoma State pulled away. It was 21-12 after one quarter. Ndiaye scored five quick points to start the second half and then Cooks had four as the Cowgirls opened the third quarter with an 11-1 spurt to get the lead to 36. Up next Little Rock: vs. Tennessee Tech in Virgin Islands on Thursday. Oklahoma State: vs. Wichita State in Kansas City on Sunday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full college basketball coverage here
